theorem ownInitializing_of_empty [GoGlobalContext] (getInit : GoString → IProp GF) : ownGoState ∅ ⊢
    ownInitializing getInit

theorem init_adequate [GoGlobalContext] [hPre : GooseGpreS GF] [lctx : GoLocalContext] (init : val)
    (body : Expr) (φ : val → Prop) (hφ : ∀ (p : val), ¬φ p.PanicV) (σ : state) (g : GlobalState)
    (Hinitg : extsInitgP g.globalWorld) (Hinitw : extsInitP σ.world g.globalWorld) (Hlctx :
    σ.goState.goLctx = lctx) (Hinit : IsInit σ) (Hthreads : σ.threads = 1) (n : Nat) (κs : List
    Observation) (t2 : List Expr) (σ2 : CfgState) (Hsteps : RealNsteps n ([init (intoVal ()) ;;
    body], σ, g) κs (t2, σ2)) (Hprog : ∀ (hG : HeapGS HasLC.hasLC GF), receiptBound GF = n + 1 →
    threadBound GF = n + 2 → progOk0 init body φ) : (∀ (v : val) (t2' : List Expr), t2 = v :: t2' →
    φ v) ∧ (∀ (e2 : Expr), e2 ∈ t2 → RealNotStuck e2 σ2) ∧ ∀ (v : val), v ∈ t2 → v.isPanic = false

def progOk [GoGlobalContext] (R B : IProp GF) (init : val) (body : Expr) (φ : val → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ getInit I,
    (⊢
        ∀ Φ,
          ownInitializing getInit ∗ R -∗
            ▷ (ownInitializing getInit ∗ I -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP (init (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) ∧
      (⊢ I -∗ threadTok -∗ B -∗ WP body {{ v, ⌜φ v⌝ }})

def heapWith (hG : HeapGS HasLC.hasLC GF) (lctx : GoLocalContext) : HeapGS HasLC.hasLC GF :=
  { goose_globalGS := HeapGS.goose_globalGS,
    goose_localGS :=
      have __src := HeapGS.goose_localGS;
      { gooseExtsLocalGS := gooseExtsLocalGS, goose_go_local_context := lctx,
        goose_na_heapGS := GooseLocalGS.goose_na_heapGS, goose_go_stateGS := GooseLocalGS.goose_go_stateGS,
        goose_threadGS := GooseLocalGS.goose_threadGS, goose_crashGS := GooseLocalGS.goose_crashGS } }

theorem wp_of_progOk [GoGlobalContext] (R B : IProp GF) (init : val) (body : Expr) (φ : val → Prop)
    (h : progOk R B init body φ) : ⊢ ownGoState ∅ -∗ threadTok -∗ R -∗ B ={⊤}=∗ WP (init (intoVal
    ()) ;; body) {{ v, ⌜φ v⌝ }}

theorem etcd_adequate [GoGlobalContext] [hPre : GooseGpreS GF] [lctx : GoLocalContext] (init : val)
    (body : Expr) (φ : val → Prop) (hφ : ∀ (p : val), ¬φ p.PanicV) (As : List GoString) (hAs :
    As.Nodup) (hAsLit : ∀ (a : GoString), a ∈ As → netAddrLit a = true) (Ds : List GoString) (hDs :
    Ds.Nodup) (σ : state) (g : GlobalState) (Hinitg : extsInitgP g.globalWorld) (Hinitw : extsInitP
    σ.world g.globalWorld) (Hlctx : σ.goState.goLctx = lctx) (Hinit : IsInit σ) (Hthreads :
    σ.threads = 1) (HNs : prometheus.namesUnclaimed (init (intoVal ()) ;; body)
    [read.slowReadIndexName, read.readIndexFailedName]) (HAs : addrsUnclaimed (init (intoVal ()) ;;
    body) As) (HDs : dataDirsAbsent (init (intoVal ()) ;; body) Ds) (HEnv : verifyEnvOff (init
    (intoVal ()) ;; body)) (n : Nat) (κs : List Observation) (t2 : List Expr) (σ2 : CfgState)
    (Hsteps : RealNsteps n ([init (intoVal ()) ;; body], σ, g) κs (t2, σ2)) (Hprog : ∀ (hG : HeapGS
    HasLC.hasLC GF), receiptBound GF = n + 1 → threadBound GF = max (n + 2) srvRevokeK → progOk
    read.readRegPerm iprop(([∗list] a ∈ As, netAddrFree a) ∗ ([∗list] a ∈ As, httpProtoFree a) ∗
    ([∗list] d ∈ Ds, dataDirFresh d) ∗ envVerifyOff) init body φ) : (∀ (v : val) (t2' : List Expr),
    t2 = v :: t2' → φ v) ∧ (∀ (e2 : Expr), e2 ∈ t2 → RealNotStuck e2 σ2) ∧ ∀ (v : val), v ∈ t2 →
    v.isPanic = false

    σ.world g.globalWorld) (Hlctx : σ.goState.goLctx = lctx) (Hinit : IsInit σ) (Hthreads :
    σ.threads = 1) (HNs : prometheus.namesUnclaimed (init (intoVal ()) ;; body)
    [read.slowReadIndexName, read.readIndexFailedName]) (HAs : addrsUnclaimed (init (intoVal ()) ;;
    body) As) (HDs : dataDirsAbsent (init (intoVal ()) ;; body) Ds) (HEnv : verifyEnvOff (init
    (intoVal ()) ;; body)) (n : Nat) (κs : List Observation) (t2 : List Expr) (σ2 : CfgState)
    (Hsteps : RealNsteps n ([init (intoVal ()) ;; body], σ, g) κs (t2, σ2)) (Hprog : ∀ (hG : HeapGS
    HasLC.hasLC GF), receiptBound GF = n + 1 → threadBound GF = max (n + 2) srvRevokeK → ∃ X T, (⊢
    |==> ∃ x, T x) ∧ ∀ (x : X), progOk read.readRegPerm iprop((([∗list] a ∈ As, netAddrFree a) ∗
    ([∗list] a ∈ As, httpProtoFree a) ∗ ([∗list] d ∈ Ds, dataDirFresh d) ∗ envVerifyOff) ∗ T x) init
    body φ) : (∀ (v : val) (t2' : List Expr), t2 = v :: t2' → φ v) ∧ (∀ (e2 : Expr), e2 ∈ t2 →
    RealNotStuck e2 σ2) ∧ ∀ (v : val), v ∈ t2 → v.isPanic = false

theorem adequate_of_unrecovered {t2 : List Expr} {P Q : Prop} (H : P ∧ Q ∧ ∀ (e2 : Expr), e2 ∈ t2 →
    ¬UnrecoveredPanic e2) : P ∧ Q ∧ ∀ (v : val), v ∈ t2 → v.isPanic = false

def progOk0 [GoGlobalContext] (init : val) (body : Expr) (φ : val → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∃ getInit I,
    (⊢
        ∀ Φ,
          ownInitializing getInit -∗
            ▷ (ownInitializing getInit ∗ I -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP (init (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) ∧
      (⊢ I -∗ threadTok -∗ WP body {{ v, ⌜φ v⌝ }})
